_instructions: Freeze this file (sha256) before the first scoring run. Filling it in after
seeing the system's answers invalidates the result.
asked_day is the day whose end the query is asked at: the store only holds
history up to and including that day.
asked_at must be an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; it anchors the 24-hour ablation.
expect_room / expect_anchor must use the store's labels. Run
to see the labels, then verify each answer against the video before writing
it here. Never copy the system's answer without checking.
expect_present=false marks an abstention test: the item is not in the video.
